description: This file contains shell script tests for Git rev-list functionality involving bitmaps and filters, including setup, various filter tests, and traversal checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with a given message or identifier.

methods.name: git repack
methods.description: Repackages Git objects into a pack file.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a new tag in the repository.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates a new object in the object database.

methods.name: git rev-list
methods.description: Lists commit objects in reverse chronological order with various filters.
